name: Foresail-1p
note: Skylink frame carrying CCSDS PUS packets (AX100 ASM framing, decoded by gr-satellites). Layout from the SatNOGS foresail1p.ksy; offsets assume the 5-byte Skylink extension seen in every recorded frame. Verified on two real frames (UHF and ADCS housekeeping); the other frame types are untested.

frame_types.label: Repeater frame (VC 3, AX.25)
frame_types.note: Per SatNOGS ksy only; not seen in a recording. Assumes no digipeater addresses and a 6-byte tail (FCS + frame CRC).

fields.name: fs_free_space

frame_types.note: Layout from the SatNOGS ksy only; not seen in a recording.

frame_types.label: UHF housekeeping (PUS 3,4)

fields.name: mcu_wd_reset_count
fields.label: Mcu wd reset count (MCU Watchdog Reset Count)

fields.name: unknown_u16_after_ham_rx
fields.label: Not in the SatNOGS ksy: 2 bytes between ham RX frames and hardware side A boot count (seen in a real frame)

fields.name: hardware_side_a_bootcount
fields.label: Hardware side a bootcount (Hardware Side A Boot Count)

fields.name: hardware_side_b_bootcount
fields.label: Hardware side b bootcount (Hardware Side B Boot Count)

frame_types.note: Checked against a real frame (2026-10-18): timestamp, uptime, boot counts, hardware side, GFSK 9600 modes and the 250 ms Skylink windows are plausible. The real frame has 2 bytes the SatNOGS ksy lacks after the ham RX frame counter (shown as unknown_u16_after_ham_rx). The RSSI values (-55, 8, 0 dBm) looked implausible in the one frame seen.

frame_types.label: ADCS housekeeping (PUS 3,5)

fields.name: attitude_quaternion_index
fields.label: Attitude quaternion: index of the omitted largest component

fields.name: attitude_quaternion_sign
fields.label: Attitude quaternion: sign of the omitted component (1 = negative)

fields.name: attitude_quaternion_largest
fields.label: Attitude quaternion: omitted largest component (computed from the other three)

frame_types.note: Checked against a real frame (2026-10-18): length and MJD (61331.0625 = 2026-10-18 01:30 UTC) match; the ADCS was off (zero position/velocity, identity quaternion). The magnetometer measurement (about 12000 raw) is far above the Earth field if the ksy unit (microtesla) is right, so that unit is doubtful.
